title: MTQC / Medical document intelligence
sentences: Medical documents combine language, anatomy, numbers, and visual structure.
M T Q C brings source comparison, local document extraction, and multilingual A I drafts into one review workspace.

title: 01 / Compare the evidence
sentences: Start with a licensed anatomy specimen and inspect the original beside its translated layout.
These saved examples cover eighteen target languages, including Korean, Spanish, and right to left Arabic.
Each specimen links to its editable artifact and documented source. These are recorded outputs, not new model calls.

title: 02 / Inspect structure, then translate
sentences: Now we open an original two column demonstration document. The file stays in the browser.
Numbered regions expose the proposed reading order. A reviewer can switch to row order for tables, inspect the source, and correct the extracted text.
We select a short passage, choose Arabic, and approve the source before sending it.
This is a genuine request to an N V I D I A Nemotron model through Nebius Token Factory. The key stays on the server.
The progress indicator is an estimate. The returned draft shows its model, token usage, and quality review notes.

title: 03 / Quality is evidence
sentences: Regression checks cover numeric changes, missing values, lost minus signs, mixed scanned pages, and reading order.
The current release passes forty six server checks, six layout checks, and twenty two browser checks.
M T Q C supports expert review. It is not clinically validated, and live translation currently covers reviewed excerpts, not complete textbook reconstruction.
